facets.description: getClientsWithPermission (lines 136-144) enumerates with findByType(server, 'Clients'), which does not match the type key used to store or look up per-client resources (hasPermission uses server.getId()), so the result is a wrong or empty set of client ids
The all-clients resource-type resource named 'Clients' is also returned by findByType, so its name is added to the granted set as a bogus client id
